sigil/voice/dispatch.py → repo root is three parents up (sigil/<pkg>/voice/..)\n20\t    repo_root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]\n21\t    for base in (repo_root, Path(\"/home/kali/sigil\")):\n22\t        for p in (f\"kernel/target/release/{exe}\", f\"kernel/target/debug/{exe}\"):\n23\t            if (base / p).exists():\n24\t                return str(base / p)\n25\t    return exe\n26\t\n27\t\n28\tclass KernelDispatch:\n29\t    def __init__(self, kernel_bin: str | None = None, timeout: int = 60):\n30\t        self.kernel_bin = kernel_bin or _default_bin()\n31\t        self.timeout = timeout\n32\t\n33\t    # Ceiling\n2\tA1 (research never touches external state). Its focus is EPISTEMICS: every claim carries a\n3\tsource and a verbatim quote, confidence is explicit, and a claim that does NOT verify against its\n4\tcited source is DEMOTED (not asserted) — the same serve-the-quote gate that governs the\n5\tconsolidation, reused here. The synthesizer is pluggable\n7\t(`ClaudeSynthesizer` via `claude -p`, or a deterministic double).\"\"\"\n8\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n9\t\n10\timport json\n11\timport re\n12\timport subprocess\n13\tfrom typing import Dict, List, Optional, Protocol, runtime_checkable\n14\t\n15\tfrom ..consolidate.gate import salient   # reuse the veracity tokenizer\n16\tfrom .base import Agent, AgentResult, Proposal, Tier\n17\tfrom .sources import read_source\n18\t\n19\t_WS = re.compile(r\"\\s+\")\n20\t_MIN_QUOTE_SALIENT = 2\n21\t\n22\t\n23\tdef _norm(t: str) -> str:\n24\t    return _WS.sub(\" \", (t or \"\")).strip().lower()\n25\t\n26\t\n27\tdef grounds_in_source(quote: str, source_text: str) -> bool:\n28\t    \"\"\"A claim's quote must be verbatim in the cited source AND specific (≥2 salient tokens) —\n29\t    exactly the serve-the-quote discipline, applied to research sources.\"\"\"\n30\t    q = _norm(quote)\n31\t    if not q or len(salient(quote)) < _MIN_QUOTE_SALIENT:\n32\t        return False\n33\t    return q in _norm(source_text)\n34\t\n35\t\n36\t@runtime_checkable\n37\tclass Synthesizer(Protocol):\n38\t    def synthesize(self, question: str, docs: Dict[str, str]) -> List[dict]: ...  # [{claim,source,quote,confidence}]\n39\t\n40\t\n41\tclass ClaudeSynthesizer:\n42\t    \"\"\"`claude -p` over the sources → JSON claims, each citing a source ref + a verbatim quote.\"\"\"\n43\t    def __init__(self, claude_bin: str = \"/home/kali/.local/bin/claude\",\n44\t                 model: str = \"claude-haiku-4-5-20251001\", timeout: int = 180):\n45\t        self.claude_bin, self.model, self.timeout = claude_bin, model, timeout\n46\t\n47\t    def synthesize(self, question: str, docs: Dict[str, str]) -> List[dict]:\n48\t        rendered = \"\\n\\n\".join(f\"[SOURCE {ref}]\\n{text[:4000]}\" for ref, text in docs.items())\n49\t        prompt = (\n50\t            \"You are a research analyst. Answer the QUESTION using ONLY the SOURCES. For every claim, \"\n51\t            \"cite the exact source ref and copy a VERBATIM quote from it that supports the claim; if a \"\n52\t            \"source does not support a claim, do not make it. If sources DISAGREE, report both. Return \"\n53\t            'ONLY a JSON array: [{\"claim\":\"...\",\"source\":\"<ref>\",\"quote\":\"<verbatim>\",\"confidence\":<0..1>}].'\n54\t            f\"\\n\\nQUESTION: {question}\\n\\nSOURCES:\\n{rendered}\\n\"\n55\t        )\n56\t        try:\n57\t            proc = subprocess.run([self.claude_bin, \"-p\", prompt, \"--model\", self.model],\n58\t                                  capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=self.timeout)\n59\t        except (subprocess.SubprocessError, OSError):\n60\t            return []\n61\t        m = re.search(r\"\\[.*\\]\", proc.stdout, re.S)\n62\t        if not m:\n63\t            return []\n64\t        try:\n65\t            items = json.loads(m.group(0))\n66\t        except json.JSONDecodeError:\n67\t            return []\n68\t        out = []\n69\t        for it in items if isinstance(items, list) else []:\n70\t            if isinstance(it, dict) and it.get(\"claim\") and it.get(\"source\"):\n71\t                out.append({\"claim\": str(it[\"claim\"]), \"source\": str(it[\"source\"]),\n72\t                            \"quote\": str(it.get(\"quote\", \"\")), \"confidence\": float(it.get(\"confidence\", 0.5) or 0.5)})\n73\t        return out\n74\t\n75\t\n76\tdef compose_report(question: str, graded: List[dict], sources: List[str]) -> str:\n77\t    grounded = [g for g in graded if g[\"grounded\"]]\n78\t    lines = [f\"# SCHOLAR research — {question}\", \"\",\n79\t             f\"Sources consulted: {len(sources)}. Claims: {len(graded)} \"\n80\t             f\"({len(grounded)} source-verified, {len(graded) - len(grounded)} unverified).\", \"\"]\n81\t    if grounded:\n82\t        # SERVE THE QUOTE, not the model's claim: the authoritative content is the verbatim source\n83\t        # span (which is what actually verified). The model's claim is advisory ONLY — a fabricated\n84\t        # claim paired with a real quote must NOT be presented as a source-verified fact.\n85\t        lines.append(\"## Source-verified spans (the authoritative evidence, verbatim)\")\n86\t        for g in sorted(grounded, key=lambda x: -x[\"confidence\"]):\n87\t            lines.append(f\"- \\\"{g['quote'][:200]}\\\"\")\n88\t            lines.append(f\"    — {g['source']}  ·  model's reading (ADVISORY, not verified): \"\n89\t                         f\"{g['claim'][:120]}  [{g['confidence']:.0%}]\")\n90\t    ungrounded = [g for g in graded if not g[\"grounded\"]]\n91\t    if ungrounded:\n92\t        lines.append(\"\\n## Unverified (the model asserted these but no verbatim source span backs them — NOT relied upon)\")\n93\t        for g in ungrounded:\n94\t            lines.append(f\"- {g['claim'][:120]}  (claimed source {g['source']})\")\n95\t    return \"\\n\".join(lines)\n96\t\n97\t\n98\tclass Scholar(Agent):\n99\t    name = \"SCHOLAR\"\n100\t    mandate = \"sourced research; claims carry sources + confidence; disagreement reported, not averaged\"\n101\t    ceiling = Tier.A1\n102\t\n103\t    def run(self, question: str, sources: List[str], *, synthesizer: Optional[Synthesizer] = None) -> AgentResult:\n104\t        docs = {ref: read_source(ref) for ref in sources}\n105\t        claims = (synthesizer or ClaudeSynthesizer()).synthesize(question, docs)\n106\t        graded = [{**c, \"grounded\": grounds_in_source(c.get(\"quote\", \"\"), docs.get(c[\"source\"], \"\"))}\n107\t                  for c in claims]\n108\t        text = compose_report(question, graded, sources)\n109\t        g = sum(1 for x in graded if x[\"grounded\"])\n110\t        res = self._dispatch([Proposal(\"report\", {\n111\t            \"subject\": question, \"text\": text, \"sources\": sources,\n112\t            \"claims\": len(graded), \"grounded\": g}, Tier.A1)])\n113\t        res.notes.append(f\"researched '{question[:50]}' over {len(sources)} source(s): \"\n114\t                         f\"{g}/{len(graded)} claims source-verified\")\n115\t        return res\n116\t"}]},"uuid":"0b999937-cc0e-4dc1-b519-059dbadf3a79","timestamp":"2026-07-19T09:11:58.093Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"e5844c15-9f09-4fcb-b726-2dbd9b0a8cc0","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

{"parentUuid":"ddd17d43-22a8-4089-a7ca-ee52d0c23c36","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"3f8d7a84-2083-490c-adb3-be5a0da7c099","agentId":"a419e7af2f182bae7","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01A3YZuc3exYnYU9Ro74XVAs","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"Orchestrate the agent mesh (SIGIL §4). v1 = ARCHIVIST → SENTINEL → STEWARD → ENVOY, each\n2\tgated by its autonomy ceiling and writing provenance-linked spine records. `morning` produces\n3\tthe acceptance deliverable (the unprompted brief, with SENTINEL alerts folded in).\"\"\"\n4\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n5\t\n6\tfrom typing import Optional\n7\t\n8\tfrom ..spine.store import SpineStore\n9\tfrom .envoy import Envoy, FileInbox, InboxSource\n10\tfrom .sentinel import Sentinel, SpineActivityWatcher, SystemHealthWatcher\n11\tfrom .steward import Steward\n12\t\n13\t\n14\tdef _sentinel_scan(store: SpineStore):\n15\t    head = store.next_seq - 1\n16\t    return Sentinel(store).run([\n17\t        SpineActivityWatcher(store, since_seq=max(-1, head - 500)),\n18\t        SystemHealthWatcher(),\n19\t    ])\n20\t\n21\t\n22\tdef _load_bastion(store: SpineStore):\n23\t    \"\"\"Build a BASTION from ~/.sigil/bastion-assets.json (+ optional bastion-cve-feed.json) if\n24\t    present; None otherwise. Keeps the default brief path unchanged when no infra is configured.\"\"\"\n25\t    import json\n26\t    import sys\n27\t\n28\t    from ..config import SIGIL_HOME\n29\t    from .bastion import Asset, Bastion\n30\t    inv_f = SIGIL_HOME / \"bastion-assets.json\"\n31\t    if not inv_f.exists():\n32\t        return None\n33\t    try:\n34\t        raw = json.loads(inv_f.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n35\t        items = raw.get(\"assets\", raw) if isinstance(raw, dict) else raw\n36\t    except (OSError, ValueError):\n37\t        return None\n38\t    # Build assets PER ITEM: a single malformed entry (typo'd key, wrong type) is skipped with a loud\n39\t    # stderr signal — never all-or-nothing, which would silently hide a real misconfiguration (RP-3).\n40\t    inv = []\n41\t    for a in items if isinstance(items, list) else []:\n42\t        try:\n43\t            inv.append(Asset(name=a[\"name\"], kind=a[\"kind\"], ref=a[\"ref\"], meta=a.get(\"meta\")))\n44\t        except (KeyError, TypeError) as e:\n45\t            print(f\"  [BASTION] skipping malformed asset entry {a!r}: missing/invalid {e}\", file=sys.stderr)\n46\t    if not inv:\n47\t        return None\n48\t    feed = []\n49\t    feed_f = SIGIL_HOME / \"bastion-cve-feed.json\"\n50\t    if feed_f.exists():\n51\t        try:\n52\t            feed = json.loads(feed_f.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n53\t        except (OSError, ValueError):\n54\t            feed = []\n55\t    return Bastion(store, inventory=inv, cve_feed=feed)\n56\t\n57\t\n58\tdef morning(store: Optional[SpineStore] = None, *, date_label: str = \"today\", bastion=None) -> dict:\n59\t    \"\"\"Run SENTINEL + BASTION (so their alerts/findings are fresh), then STEWARD's brief which folds\n60\t    them in. `bastion` may be injected (tests); otherwise it auto-loads from config if present.\"\"\"\n61\t    store = store or SpineStore()\n62\t    sent = _sentinel_scan(store)\n63\t    b = bastion if bastion is not None else _load_bastion(store)\n64\t    bres = b.run() if b is not None else None\n65\t    stew = Steward(store)\n66\t    stew_res = stew.run(date_label=date_label)\n67\t    brief = stew.brief_text(date_label=date_label)   # composed AFTER SENTINEL/BASTION wrote records\n68\t    out = {\"sentinel\": sent, \"steward\": stew_res, \"brief\": brief}\n69\t    if bres is not None:\n70\t        out[\"bastion\"] = bres\n71\t    return out\n72\t\n73\t\n74\tdef triage(store: Optional[SpineStore] = None, *, inbox: Optional[InboxSource] = None,\n75\t           inbox_path: Optional[str] = None) -> dict:\n76\t    store = store or SpineStore()\n77\t    src = inbox or FileInbox(inbox_path or \"/home/kali/.sigil/inbox.json\")\n78\t    res = Envoy(store).run(src)\n79\t    return {\"envoy\": res}\n80\t\n81\t\n82\tdef run_all(store: Optional[SpineStore] = None, *, inbox_path: Optional[str] = None,\n83\t            consolidate: bool = False) -> dict:\n84\t    store = store or SpineStore()\n85\t    out: dict = {}\n86\t    if consolidate:\n87\t        from .archivist import Archivist\n88\t        out[\"archivist\"] = Archivist(store).run()\n89\t    out.update(morning(store))\n90\t    out.update(triage(store, inbox_path=inbox_path))\n91\t    return out\n92\t"}]},"uuid":"81a7850e-22fe-417b-9dc7-547ca4c487ef","timestamp":"2026-07-19T09:12:02.229Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"ddd17d43-22a8-4089-a7ca-ee52d0c23c36","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

{"parentUuid":"db523db5-ed09-4696-8329-1b09c8a890a8","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"3f8d7a84-2083-490c-adb3-be5a0da7c099","agentId":"a419e7af2f182bae7","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_0143wsNAxKHU8moLckVcb5bd","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"ARTIFICER (SIGIL §4.4) — engineering: drives headless Claude Code against a repo to own a\n2\tcoding task end to end. Ceiling A2 (a PR ready-for-review queues for approval); `git push` to a\n3\tprotected branch, deploys, and dependency additions are A3 — ARTIFICER NEVER pushes.\n4\t\n5\tCorrectness discipline (the §4.4 focus): it runs the tests BEFORE claiming done — a PR is\n6\tproposed ONLY if the test command passes on the change; a failing change is reported, not\n7\tshipped. The result is a local branch + a plain-language diff summary, QUEUED for the human to\n8\treview and push. The coder is pluggable: `ClaudeCoder` (headless `claude -p`) or a deterministic\n9\ttest double.\"\"\"\n10\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n11\t\n12\timport re\n13\timport shutil\n14\timport subprocess\n15\timport tempfile\n16\tfrom pathlib import Path\n17\tfrom typing import List, Optional, Protocol, runtime_checkable\n18\t\n19\tfrom ..reuse import sha256_hex\n20\tfrom .base import Agent, AgentResult, Proposal, Tier\n21\t\n22\t# commands that \"pass\" trivially — a PR must never claim tests passing on one of these.\n23\t_TRIVIAL_TEST = frozenset({(), (\"true\",), (\":\",), (\"/bin/true\",), (\"/usr/bin/true\",)})\n24\t\n25\t\n26\tdef _git(repo: str, *args: str, check: bool = True) -> str:\n27\t    proc = subprocess.run([\"git\", \"-C\", repo, *args], capture_output=True, text=True)\n28\t    if check and proc.returncode != 0:\n29\t        raise RuntimeError(f\"git {' '.join(args)} failed: {proc.stderr.strip()}\")\n30\t    return proc.stdout\n31\t\n32\t\n33\tdef _slug(task: str) -> str:\n34\t    base = re.sub(r\"[^a-z0-9]+\", \"-\", task.lower()).strip(\"-\")[:28] or \"task\"\n35\t    return f\"{base}-{sha256_hex(task.encode())[:6]}\"   # unique per task, stable\n36\t\n37\t\n38\t@runtime_checkable\n39\tclass Coder(Protocol):\n40\t    def code(self, task: str, workdir: str) -> str: ...   # perform the change; return a summary\n41\t\n42\t\n43\tclass ClaudeCoder:\n44\t    \"\"\"Headless Claude Code (`claude -p`) run inside the repo — the real ARTIFICER worker.\"\"\"\n45\t    def __init__(self, claude_bin: str = \"/home/kali/.local/bin/claude\", timeout: int = 600):\n46\t        self.claude_bin, self.timeout = claude_bin, timeout\n47\t\n48\t    def code(self, task: str, workdir: str) -> str:\n49\t        prompt = (f\"You are working in the repo at {workdir}. Task: {task}\\n\"\n50\t                  \"Make the minimal change to accomplish it. Do not run git. Do not touch unrelated files.\")\n51\t        # acceptEdits lets the headless coder actually apply Edit/Write in its sandboxed repo (it\n52\t        # cannot prompt for permission in -p mode). ARTIFICER's isolation is the per-task branch;\n53\t        # git push / deploy stay A3 and are never invoked here.\n54\t        try:\n55\t            proc = subprocess.run(\n56\t                [self.claude_bin, \"-p\", prompt, \"--permission-mode\", \"acceptEdits\"],\n57\t                cwd=workdir, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=self.timeout)\n58\t        except (subprocess.SubprocessError, OSError) as e:\n59\t            return f\"(coder error: {e})\"\n60\t        return (proc.stdout or \"\").strip()[:400]\n61\t\n62\t\n63\tclass Artificer(Agent):\n64\t    name = \"ARTIFICER\"\n65\t    mandate = \"own background coding tasks: tests before done, PRs not pushes\"\n66\t    ceiling = Tier.A2\n67\t\n68\t    def run(self, task: str, *, repo: str, test_cmd: Optional[List[str]] = None,\n69\t            coder: Optional[Coder] = None, branch: Optional[str] = None) -> AgentResult:\n70\t        coder = coder or ClaudeCoder()\n71\t        base = _git(repo, \"rev-parse\", \"--abbrev-ref\", \"HEAD\").strip()\n72\t        branch = branch or f\"artificer/{_slug(task)}\"\n73\t\n74\t        # ISOLATION: the coder works in a dedicated git WORKTREE off `base`, so the real working\n75\t        # tree is never touched, no pre-existing/unrelated edits get bundled, and a failure leaves\n76\t        # the main repo exactly as it was. The per-task branch survives for the human to review.\n77\t        _git(repo, \"worktree\", \"prune\", check=False)\n78\t        wt = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=\"artificer-wt-\")\n79\t        _git(repo, \"worktree\", \"add\", \"-B\", branch, wt, base)\n80\t        try:\n81\t            summary = coder.code(task, wt)\n82\t            changed = bool(_git(wt, \"status\", \"--porcelain\", check=False).strip())\n83\t            diff = _git(wt, \"diff\", \"--stat\", check=False).strip()\n84\t\n85\t            if not changed:\n86\t                res = AgentResult(agent=self.name)\n87\t                res.notes.append(\"no change produced for the task — nothing to propose.\")\n88\t                return res\n89\t\n90\t            real_test = test_cmd is not None and tuple(test_cmd) not in _TRIVIAL_TEST\n91\t            if not real_test:\n92\t                # NEVER claim \"tests passing\" without a real test command — record UNVERIFIED, withhold PR.\n93\t                res = self._dispatch([Proposal(\"finding\", {\n94\t                    \"summary\": f\"ARTIFICER task '{task}': change made but NO real test command was run — UNVERIFIED, PR withheld\",\n95\t                    \"branch\": branch, \"diffstat\": diff, \"coder\": summary}, Tier.A1)])\n96\t                res.notes.append(\"no real test command → change is UNVERIFIED; PR withheld (correctness discipline)\")\n97\t                return res\n98\t\n99\t            test = subprocess.run(test_cmd, cwd=wt, capture_output=True, text=True)\n100\t            if test.returncode != 0:\n101\t                tail = (test.stdout + test.stderr).strip().splitlines()\n102\t                res = self._dispatch([Proposal(\"finding\", {\n103\t                    \"summary\": f\"ARTIFICER task '{task}': change made but tests FAIL — PR withheld\",\n104\t                    \"branch\": branch, \"test_tail\": tail[-3:] if tail else [], \"diffstat\": diff}, Tier.A1)])\n105\t                res.notes.append(\"tests failed after the change — PR withheld (correctness discipline)\")\n106\t                return res\n107\t\n108\t            # tests genuinely pass → commit on the branch (in the worktree), propose a PR (A2, QUEUED).\n109\t            _git(wt, \"add\", \"-A\")\n110\t            _git(wt, \"commit\", \"-m\", f\"ARTIFICER: {task}\", check=False)\n111\t            res = self._dispatch([Proposal(\"pr\", {\n112\t                \"subject\": task, \"branch\": branch, \"base\": base, \"diffstat\": diff,\n113\t                \"summary\": summary, \"tests\": f\"passing ({' '.join(test_cmd)})\",\n114\t                \"note\": \"ready-for-review; ARTIFICER does NOT push — a human reviews and pushes\"}, Tier.A2)])\n115\t            res.notes.append(f\"task done, tests PASS → PR proposed on branch '{branch}' (A2, awaiting approval)\")\n116\t            return res\n117\t        finally:\n118\t            _git(repo, \"worktree\", \"remove\", \"--force\", wt, check=False)\n119\t            shutil.rmtree(wt, ignore_errors=True)\n120\t"}]},"uuid":"f9494b5e-d248-4a02-8cdb-38cba578cf54","timestamp":"2026-07-19T09:12:02.717Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"db523db5-ed09-4696-8329-1b09c8a890a8","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

{"parentUuid":"55254cad-7411-4903-a804-9c1793661be4","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"3f8d7a84-2083-490c-adb3-be5a0da7c099","agentId":"a419e7af2f182bae7","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_018eQGKA1voeVzwLuEwTETSD","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"Git commit-history ingestion (SIGIL §3 / §6.2 git source).\n2\t\n3\tBackfills commit messages (subject + body) from allowlisted repos as `commit` spine\n4\tevents. Excludes the huge/binary repos (RECOR 257 GB, vendored flutter) per the disk\n5\tallowlist doctrine. A `post-commit`/`post-merge` hook (0b) keeps it live going forward.\n6\t\n7\t**Incremental by construction.** Each repo's last-ingested commit hash is persisted in the\n8\tshared ingest cursor under a `git:<repo>` key, so re-running (which the hook does on *every*\n9\tcommit) appends only new commits — never the whole history again. Commits are appended\n10\toldest-first so the spine's seq order tracks chronology.\n11\t\"\"\"\n12\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n13\t\n14\timport subprocess\n15\tfrom pathlib import Path\n16\tfrom typing import Iterator\n17\t\n18\tfrom . import cursor as cur\n19\tfrom ..spine.store import SpineStore\n20\t\n21\t# high-signal repos to ingest (relative to /home/kali). Excludes RECOR (257 GB) + flutter.\n22\tDEFAULT_REPOS = [\n23\t    \"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main\",\n24\t    \"/home/kali/sigil\",\n25\t]\n26\t\n27\t_SEP_FIELD = \"\\x1f\"\n28\t_SEP_REC = \"\\x1e\"\n29\t_FMT = _SEP_FIELD.join([\"%H\", \"%an\", \"%aI\", \"%s\", \"%b\"]) + _SEP_REC\n30\t\n31\t\n32\tdef git_log(repo: Path, *, since: str | None = None, max_commits: int = 5000) -> list[dict]:\n33\t    \"\"\"Newest-first list of commits. With `since`, only commits after that hash (`since..HEAD`).\"\"\"\n34\t    if not (repo / \".git\").exists():\n35\t        return []\n36\t    # range (if any) must come immediately AFTER `log`, before the pretty/limit flags.\n37\t    rev = [f\"{since}..HEAD\"] if since else []\n38\t    cmd = [\"git\", \"-C\", str(repo), \"log\", *rev, f\"--pretty=format:{_FMT}\", \"-n\", str(max_commits)]\n39\t    try:\n40\t        out = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120).stdout\n41\t    except (subprocess.SubprocessError, OSError):\n42\t        return []\n43\t    commits = []\n44\t    for rec in out.split(_SEP_REC):\n45\t        rec = rec.strip()\n46\t        if not rec:\n47\t            continue\n48\t        parts = rec.split(_SEP_FIELD)\n49\t        if len(parts) >= 4:\n50\t            commits.append({\"hash\": parts[0], \"author\": parts[1], \"date\": parts[2],\n51\t                            \"subject\": parts[3], \"body\": parts[4] if len(parts) > 4 else \"\"})\n52\t    return commits\n53\t\n54\t\n55\tdef ingest_git(store: SpineStore, repos: list[str] | None = None, *,\n56\t               cursor: dict | None = None, max_commits: int = 5000) -> int:\n57\t    # when the caller owns the cursor (cmd_ingest), mutate its dict in place and let it save —\n58\t    # saving our own copy here would be clobbered by the caller's later save. Standalone → own it.\n59\t    own = cursor is None\n60\t    cursor = cur.load() if own else cursor\n61\t    added = 0\n62\t    for repo in (repos or DEFAULT_REPOS):\n63\t        p = Path(repo)\n64\t        key = f\"git:{p.name}\"\n65\t        since = cursor.get(key) or None\n66\t        commits = git_log(p, since=since, max_commits=max_commits)  # newest-first\n67\t        if not commits:\n68\t            continue\n69\t        newest = commits[0][\"hash\"]\n70\t        for c in reversed(commits):  # append oldest-first → spine seq tracks chronology\n71\t            text = c[\"subject\"] + ((\"\\n\\n\" + c[\"body\"]) if c[\"body\"].strip() else \"\")\n72\t            store.append(kind=\"commit\", source=\"git\", actor=c[\"author\"],\n73\t                         payload={\"text\": text[:4000], \"hash\": c[\"hash\"], \"repo\": p.name,\n74\t                                  \"subject\": c[\"subject\"]}, ts=c[\"date\"])\n75\t            added += 1\n76\t        cursor[key] = newest\n77\t    if own:\n78\t        cur.save(cursor)\n79\t    return added\n80\t"}]},"uuid":"125b6782-04d5-4591-949d-3446233ee4f0","timestamp":"2026-07-19T09:12:03.212Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"55254cad-7411-4903-a804-9c1793661be4","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

Respects `core.hooksPath`. Safe to re-run; `uninstall` removes only SIGIL's block.\n6\t\"\"\"\n7\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n8\t\n9\timport subprocess\n10\tfrom pathlib import Path\n11\t\n12\t_BEGIN = \"# >>> sigil-hook >>>\"\n13\t_END = \"# <<< sigil-hook <<<\"\n14\t_PY = \"/home/kali/.sigil/venv/bin/python\"\n15\t_BODY = f'{_PY} -m sigil.cli ingest --git-only >/dev/null 2>&1 || true'\n16\t_HOOKS = (\"post-commit\", \"post-merge\")\n17\t\n18\t\n19\tdef _hooks_dir(repo: Path) -> Path:\n20\t    try:\n21\t        hp = subprocess.run([\"git\", \"-C\", str(repo), \"config\", \"--get\", \"core.hooksPath\"],\n22\t                            capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10).stdout.strip()\n23\t    except (subprocess.SubprocessError, OSError):\n24\t        hp = \"\"\n25\t    return (repo / hp) if hp else (repo / \".git\" / \"hooks\")\n26\t\n27\t\n28\tdef _block() -> str:\n29\t    return f\"{_BEGIN}\\n{_BODY}\\n{_END}\\n\"\n30\t\n31\t\n32\tdef install(repo: str | Path) -> list[str]:\n33\t    repo = Path(repo)\n34\t    hd = _hooks_dir(repo)\n35\t    hd.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n36\t    done = []\n37\t    for name in _HOOKS:\n38\t        hook = hd / name\n39\t        text = hook.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\") if hook.exists() else \"#!/bin/sh\\n\"\n40\t        if _BEGIN in text:\n41\t            continue  # idempotent\n42\t        if not text.startswith(\"#!\"):\n43\t            text = \"#!/bin/sh\\n\" + text\n44\t        hook.write_text(text.rstrip(\"\\n\") + \"\\n\" + _block(), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n45\t        hook.chmod(0o755)\n46\t        done.append(name)\n47\t    return done\n48\t\n49\t\n50\tdef uninstall(repo: str | Path) -> list[str]:\n51\t    repo = Path(repo)\n52\t    hd = _hooks_dir(repo)\n53\t    done = []\n54\t    import re\n55\t    pat = re.compile(re.escape(_BEGIN) + r\".*?\" + re.escape(_END) + r\"\\n?\", re.S)\n56\t    for name in _HOOKS:\n57\t        hook = hd / name\n58\t        if hook.exists() and _BEGIN in (t := hook.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")):\n59\t            hook.write_text(pat.sub(\"\", t), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n60\t            done.append(name)\n61\t    return done\n62\t"}]},"uuid":"698b2d40-ceb5-4c30-b2da-976541a2c354","timestamp":"2026-07-19T09:12:03.739Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"770cd01f-ee68-4620-8397-5344c470cb05","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

Three implementations:\n3\t\n4\t  * AgentProvider   — headless `claude -p` on the Max plan (D5: agent-driven, zero API cost).\n5\t  * ReplayProvider  — replays a captured golden fixture (zero cost, exercises the parse path).\n6\t  * HeuristicProvider — offline keyword extraction (no LLM; a weak fallback + deterministic\n7\t                        double for tests).\n8\t\n9\tNone of these is trusted: whatever a provider proposes is only a CANDIDATE. The gate\n10\t(gate.admit) re-executes every citation before anything becomes a fact. The extraction prompt\n11\tstill injects the prove-don't-guess doctrine so the agent is asked to cite verbatim and refuse\n12\tto invent — belt (honest prompt) and suspenders (re-execution gate).\"\"\"\n13\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n14\t\n15\timport json\n16\timport re\n17\timport subprocess\n18\tfrom pathlib import Path\n19\tfrom typing import Iterable, Protocol, runtime_checkable\n20\t\n21\tfrom ..spine.models import SpineRecord\n22\tfrom .models import CandidateFact\n23\t\n24\t# the prove-don't-guess doctrine, distilled for extraction (framework/cognitive/metacognition.md).\n25\tDOCTRINE = (\n26\t    \"You extract DURABLE FACTS from a person's work log. A `decision` is a CHOICE the person \"\n27\t    \"COMMITTED TO ('we'll use X', 'decided to Y') — NOT a status update, test result, log line, \"\n28\t    \"or an instruction to someone else. A `commitment` is a PROMISE the person made, ideally with a \"\n29\t    \"due date. An `entity` is a durable named thing (project/person/tool/component). If a record is \"\n30\t    \"just narration, a result, or a task assignment, extract NOTHING from it. Rules, above all else:\\n\"\n31\t    \"1. PROVE, DON'T GUESS. Only report a fact that the provided records EXPLICITLY support. \"\n32\t    \"Never infer, embellish, or invent a decision, commitment, or entity that is not in the text.\\n\"\n33\t    \"2. CITE VERBATIM. For every fact, cite the exact record seq(s) and copy a `quote` that is a \"\n34\t    \"VERBATIM substring of a cited record. If you cannot quote it word-for-word, do not report it. \"\n35\t    \"The `statement` must be a COMPRESSION of your quote — use ONLY words that appear in the quote \"\n36\t    \"(you may drop and reorder words, but never add a word the quote does not contain).\\n\"\n37\t    \"3. REFUSE HONESTLY. If a record supports no durable fact, return fewer facts — an empty list \"\n38\t    \"is a correct answer. Do not pad.\\n\"\n39\t    \"4. DON'T FABRICATE CONFIDENCE. `confidence` is your rough estimate only; it never makes a \"\n40\t    \"weakly-supported claim strong.\\n\"\n41\t    \"5. CONTRADICTIONS. If the records show the person REVERSING an earlier decision (choosing X \"\n42\t    \"then later choosing not-X or a different option for the SAME subject), emit a kind='contradiction' \"\n43\t    \"whose source_seqs cite BOTH the earlier and later records AND provide a `quotes` array with a \"\n44\t    \"VERBATIM quote from EACH of those two records. Only flag genuine OPPOSITION, never a restatement \"\n45\t    \"or refinement of the same choice.\\n\"\n46\t)\n47\t\n48\t_SCHEMA_HINT = (\n49\t    \"Return ONLY a JSON array (no prose) of objects: \"\n50\t    '{\"kind\": \"decision\"|\"commitment\"|\"entity\"|\"contradiction\", \"subject\": \"<what it is about>\", '\n51\t    '\"statement\": \"<advisory summary in the person\\'s terms>\", \"quote\": \"<verbatim span from a cited record>\", '\n52\t    '\"quotes\": [\"<verbatim from record A>\", \"<verbatim from record B>\"] (contradictions ONLY, one per conflicting record), '\n53\t    '\"source_seqs\": [<int seq>...], \"owner\": \"<for commitments, who>\"|null, '\n54\t    '\"due_iso\": \"<ISO date if a due date is stated>\"|null, \"confidence\": <0..1>}.'\n55\t)\n56\t\n57\t\n58\t# a fast, cheap model is ideal for this mechanical extraction task.\n59\tFAST_MODEL = \"claude-haiku-4-5-20251001\"\n60\t\n61\t\n62\t@runtime_checkable\n63\tclass ExtractionProvider(Protocol):\n64\t    def extract(self, records: list[SpineRecord]) -> list[CandidateFact]: ...\n65\t\n66\t\n67\tdef render_window(records: Iterable[SpineRecord], *, max_chars: int = 1200) -> str:\n68\t    lines = []\n69\t    for r in records:\n70\t        txt = (r.text() or \"\").replace(\"\\n\", \" \").strip()\n71\t        if not txt:\n72\t            continue\n73\t        lines.append(f\"[seq {r.seq}] ({r.kind} · {r.actor}) {txt[:max_chars]}\")\n74\t    return \"\\n\".join(lines)\n75\t\n76\t\n77\tdef build_prompt(records: list[SpineRecord]) -> str:\n78\t    \"\"\"The extraction prompt every LLM provider sends (doctrine + schema + rendered window).\"\"\"\n79\t    return f\"{DOCTRINE}\\n{_SCHEMA_HINT}\\n\\nRECORDS:\\n{render_window(records)}\\n\"\n80\t\n81\t\n82\tdef parse_candidates(raw: str, *, extractor: re.search(r\"```(?:json)?\\s*(\\[.*?\\])\\s*```\", raw, re.S)\n87\t    body = fenced.group(1) if fenced else None\n88\t    if body is None:\n89\t        start, end = raw.find(\"[\"), raw.rfind(\"]\")\n90\t        body = raw[start:end + 1] if 0 <= start < end else None\n91\t    if body is None:\n92\t        return []\n93\t    try:\n94\t        items = json.loads(body)\n95\t    except json.JSONDecodeError:\n96\t        return []\n97\t    out = []\n98\t    for it in items if isinstance(items, list) else []:\n99\t        if not isinstance(it, dict) or it.get(\"kind\") not in (\"decision\", \"commitment\", \"entity\", \"contradiction\"):\n100\t            continue\n101\t        seqs = it.get(\"source_seqs\") or []\n102\t        seqs = [int(s) for s in seqs if isinstance(s, (int, float, str)) and str(s).lstrip(\"-\").isdigit()]\n103\t        raw_quotes = it.get(\"quotes\") or []\n104\t        quotes = tuple(str(q) for q in raw_quotes if isinstance(q, str) and q.strip()) if isinstance(raw_quotes, list) else ()\n105\t        out.append(CandidateFact(\n106\t            kind=it[\"kind\"], subject=str(it.get(\"subject\", \"\")).strip(),\n107\t            statement=str(it.get(\"statement\", \"\")).strip(), quote=str(it.get(\"quote\", \"\")),\n108\t            source_seqs=seqs, model_confidence=float(it.get(\"confidence\", 0.5) or 0.5),\n109\t            owner=(it.get(\"owner\") or None), due_iso=(it.get(\"due_iso\") or None),\n110\t            extractor=extractor, quotes=quotes))\n111\t    return out\n112\t\n113\t\n114\tclass AgentProvider:\n115\t    \"\"\"`--provider claude`: headless Claude Code on the MAX plan (D5, owner's preference).\n116\t    Spawns `claude -p --model <fast> <prompt>` per window — no metered API key needed. A fast\n117\t    model (Haiku) keeps each batch quick and cheap for this mechanical extraction.\"\"\"\n118\t\n119\t    def __init__(self, claude_bin: str = \"/home/kali/.local/bin/claude\",\n120\t                 model: str = FAST_MODEL, timeout: int = 180) -> None:\n121\t        self.claude_bin = claude_bin\n122\t        self.model = model\n123\t        self.timeout = timeout\n124\t\n125\t    def extract(self, records: list[SpineRecord]) -> list[CandidateFact]:\n126\t        if not records:\n127\t            return []\n128\t        cmd = [self.claude_bin, \"-p\", build_prompt(records)]\n129\t        if self.model:\n130\t            cmd += [\"--model\", self.model]\n131\t        try:\n132\t            proc = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=self.timeout)\n133\t        except (subprocess.SubprocessError, OSError):\n134\t            return []\n135\t        return parse_candidates(proc.stdout, extractor=\"agent\")\n136\t\n137\t\n138\tclass ApiProvider:\n139\t    \"\"\"`--provider api`: the metered Anthropic Messages API (Claude API key). Reads the key\n140\t    from SIGIL_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (or ~/.sigil/sigil.env via config). Raw\n141\t    HTTP — no SDK dependency. Use when you want the API rather than the Max subscription.\"\"\"\n142\t\n143\t    def __init__(self, model: str = FAST_MODEL, api_key: str | None = None,\n144\t                 timeout: int = 120, max_tokens: int = 2048) -> None:\n145\t        import os\n146\t        self.model = model\n147\t        self.api_key = api_key or os.environ.get(\"SIGIL_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY\") or os.environ.get(\"ANTHROPIC_API_KEY\")\n148\t        self.timeout = timeout\n149\t        self.max_tokens = max_tokens\n150\t\n151\t    def extract(self, records: list[SpineRecord]) -> list[CandidateFact]:\n152\t        if not records:\n153\t            return []\n154\t        if not self.api_key:\n155\t            raise RuntimeError(\"ApiProvider needs an API key — set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (or SIGIL_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY)\")\n156\t        import json as _json\n157\t        import urllib.request\n158\t        body = _json.dumps({\n159\t            \"model\": self.model, \"max_tokens\": self.max_tokens,\n160\t            \"messages\": [{\"role\": \"user\", \"content\": build_prompt(records)}],\n161\t        }).encode(\"utf-8\")\n162\t        req = urllib.request.Request(\n163\t            \"https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages\", data=body, method=\"POST\",\n164\t            headers={\"content-type\": \"application/json\", \"x-api-key\": self.api_key,\n165\t                     \"anthropic-version\": \"2023-06-01\"})\n166\t        try:\n167\t            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=self.timeout) as resp:\n168\t                payload = _json.loads(resp.read().decode(\"utf-8\"))\n169\t        except (urllib.error.URLError, OSError, ValueError):\n170\t            return []\n171\t        text = \"\".join(b.get(\"text\", \"\") for b in payload.get(\"content\", []) if isinstance(b, dict))\n172\t        return parse_candidates(text, extractor=\"api\")\n173\t\n174\t\n175\tclass LocalProvider:\n176\t    \"\"\"`--provider local`: a local Ollama model (fully offline, zero cost, no data leaves the\n177\t    box). Requires Ollama running at OLLAMA_HOST (default 127.0.0.1:11434) with `model` pulled.\"\"\"\n178\t\n179\t    def __init__(self, model: str = \"llama3.1\", host: str | None = None, timeout: int = 180) -> None:\n180\t        import os\n181\t        self.model = model\n182\t        self.host = host or os.environ.get(\"OLLAMA_HOST\") or \"http://127.0.0.1:11434\"\n183\t        self.timeout = timeout\n184\t\n185\t    def extract(self, records: list[SpineRecord]) -> list[CandidateFact]:\n186\t        if not records:\n187\t            return []\n188\t        import json as _json\n189\t        import urllib.request\n190\t        body = _json.dumps({\"model\": self.model, \"prompt\": build_prompt(records), \"stream\": False}).encode(\"utf-8\")\n191\t        req = urllib.request.Request(f\"{self.host.rstrip('/')}/api/generate\", data=body, method=\"POST\",\n192\t                                     headers={\"content-type\": \"application/json\"})\n193\t        try:\n194\t            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=self.timeout) as resp:\n195\t                payload = _json.loads(resp.read().decode(\"utf-8\"))\n196\t        except (urllib.error.URLError, OSError, ValueError):\n197\t            return []\n198\t        return parse_candidates(payload.get(\"response\", \"\"), extractor=\"local\")\n199\t\n200\t\n201\tclass ReplayProvider:\n202\t    \"\"\"Replays a captured fixture (a JSON array of candidate dicts). Zero cost; proves the\n203\t    parse/gate path end-to-end without a live call.\"\"\"\n204\t\n205\t    def __init__(self, fixture: str | Path) -> None:\n206\t        self.fixture = Path(fixture)\n207\t\n208\t    def extract(self, records: list[SpineRecord]) -> list[CandidateFact]:\n209\t        return parse_candidates(self.fixture.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"), extractor=\"replay\")\n210\t\n211\t\n212\t_DECISION_CUES = (\"decided to\", \"we'll go with\", \"going with\", \"chose to\", \"chosen:\", \"decision:\")\n213\t_COMMIT_CUES = (\"i'll \", \"i will \", \"we'll \", \"commit to\", \"todo:\", \"next step\", \"by end of\", \"due \")\n214\t\n215\t\n216\tclass HeuristicProvider:\n217\t    \"\"\"Offline, no-LLM keyword extractor — a weak fallback and a deterministic test double.\n218\t    Emits a candidate per cue-bearing sentence, quoting that sentence verbatim (so the gate\n219\t    grounds it). Deliberately conservative; the AgentProvider is the real extractor.\"\"\"\n220\t\n221\t    def extract(self, records: list[SpineRecord]) -> list[CandidateFact]:\n222\t        out = []\n223\t        for r in records:\n224\t            for sent in re.split(r\"(?<=[.!?])\\s+\", (r.text() or \"\")):\n225\t                low = sent.lower().strip()\n226\t                if not low:\n227\t                    continue\n228\t                if any(c in low for c in _DECISION_CUES):\n229\t                    out.append(CandidateFact(\"decision\", low[:60], sent.strip(), sent.strip(),\n230\t                                             [r.seq], 0.5, extractor=\"heuristic\"))\n231\t                elif any(c in low for c in _COMMIT_CUES):\n232\t                    out.append(CandidateFact(\"commitment\", low[:60], sent.strip(), sent.strip(),\n233\t                                             [r.seq], 0.5, owner=\"owner\", extractor=\"heuristic\"))\n234\t        return out\n235\t"}]},"uuid":"a3021a82-4f86-4172-8779-c73cc218e290","timestamp":"2026-07-19T09:12:03.992Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"16b5e742-66a9-4853-9b4a-2fd7da84a8b6","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

The real environment always wins (setdefault). Slugified cwd = dir name under ~/.claude/projects.\nPROJECT_ALLOWLIST = os.environ.get(\n    \"SIGIL_PROJECT_ALLOWLIST\", \"-home-kali-Pictures-PENTEST-main\"\n).split(\",\")\n# ephemeral CRUCIBLE-engine runs to filter out\nEPHEMERAL_PREFIXES = (\"-tmp-crucible-cc-\", \"-tmp-\")\n\n# --- vectors (Qdrant, local/embedded — no server, no Docker; in-process, file-backed) -\nQDRANT_PATH = SIGIL_HOME / \"qdrant\"                       # embedded local-mode store\nQDRANT_URL = os.environ.get(\"SIGIL_QDRANT_URL\", \"\")       # set to switch to a server later\nQDRANT_COLLECTION = os.environ.get(\"SIGIL_QDRANT_COLLECTION\", \"sigil_memory\")\nEMBED_MODEL = os.environ.get(\"SIGIL_EMBED_MODEL\", \"BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5\")\nEMBED_DIM = 384\n\n# --- graph (Kùzu, deterministic mirror of the spine) ----------------------------------\nGRAPH_DIR = SIGIL_HOME / \"graph\"                          # base; holds current/ + staging/ (atomic swap)\n\n# --- identity / scope -----------------------------------------------------------------\nSCOPE = os.environ.get(\"SIGIL_SCOPE\", \"sigil\")          # the owner's single scope\nOWNER_KEY_ID = os.environ.get(\"SIGIL_OWNER_KEY_ID\", \"owner\")\n\n# --- external binaries (resolved; never an operator-specific absolute path) -----------\n_CLAUDE_FALLBACK = Path.home() / \".local\" / \"bin\" / \"claude\"\n_REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]         # <repo>/sigil/config.py → <repo>\n\n\ndef claude_bin() -> str:\n    \"\"\"Resolve the `claude` CLI: env SIGIL_CLAUDE_BIN → PATH (`which claude`) → a documented\n    per-user fallback (~/.local/bin/claude).
